serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin and (as ledgerBookedMin) reserved minutes; bookedMin comes from each bucket's own table - capacity_bookings(Order), maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes offered that day; bookedMin is the authoritative booked figure from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities.reserved_minutes, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity
